turns.prompt: label.csv is the X-band CW-EPR spectrum (first derivative, field in G) of a nitroxide in fast isotropic motion. Estimate the rotational correlation time with the Kivelson formula tau_c = 6.51e-10 s/G * dB0 * (sqrt(h0/h+1) + sqrt(h0/h-1) - 2), where dB0 is the peak-to-peak width of the centre line in G and h-1, h0, h+1 are the peak-to-peak heights of the high-field, centre and low-field lines (mI = -1, 0, +1). Report tau_c in seconds (tau_c_s).

provenance: synthetic Lorentzian triplet; truth = the formula on the noise-free spectrum
